statement: GPT-5.6 Luna xhigh under the exact structured-owner-duty Codex 0.147.0 realization may apply one already selected owner-bounded eval procedure and return its named evidence artifacts, but this remains a real-work canary hypothesis until an independently reviewed eval duty demonstrates the role.

conditions: the eval owner, exact procedure, inputs, criteria and named outputs are explicit
the actor applies rather than invents proof doctrine or acceptance criteria
the work runs in an isolated projection with effects bounded by the mandate
the result returns to the eval owner for independent review and verdict meaning
the exact Codex 0.147.0 realization passes the live catalog check
the bound abyss-stack external actor runtime is artifact-admitted before launch
usage is counted from runtime receipts and never becomes a caller-authored execution budget
exclusions: inventing an eval, proof invariant, rubric or verdict scale
issuing final proof, owner acceptance, release or landing verdicts
widening the target beyond the named inputs and procedure
autonomous commit, push, merge, publication or undelegated external effect
treating schema-valid completion or green tests as role fit
inferring closed-model internal geometry or training lineage from behavior

evidence_refs.notes: Adjacent structured external-work evidence only; it does not prove evaluator-role fit.
Confirms the exact Luna xhigh and max realizations under Codex 0.147.0.
Provider capabilities and economics only; not AoA role-fit evidence.
Installed Codex CLI is 0.148.0, so the subject 0.147.0 realization is stale. This closes currentness only and does not establish replacement fit.

freshness.policy: The bounded eval-role hypothesis is preserved as historical input; the Codex 0.147.0 realization became stale on the 0.148.0 runtime transition, and a future 0.148.0 canary must re-establish currentness before fit is considered.

history.reason: Current provider/runtime facts and adjacent bounded external-work evidence justify one real-duty canary, not transferred proof.

The exact Codex 0.147.0 realization became stale when the installed Codex CLI advanced to 0.148.0. The bounded hypothesis is retained, but no replacement 0.148.0 fit or role evidence is admitted by this transition.

attribution_limits: No Luna eval-role run under this exact claim has completed.
Adjacent landing evidence does not establish evaluator-role fit or net benefit.
Provider capabilities and pricing do not prove task performance.
The first canary must use a real owner procedure and cannot self-accept its result.
Behavior cannot establish closed-model internal geometry or training lineage.
